auth: Google-login bearer (require_google_user). Read only: no agent run, no mail, no DB write.
owner_scope: work_cases, quote_versions and suppliers are filtered by the caller's owner_user_id. A missing or another user's case returns the same 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
source: work_cases.latest_review_jsonb (card), work_cases.review_revision, input_revision, status, decision, selected_plan_id, selected_plan_jsonb, selected_at, archived_at, accepted_at.
response: case_id, review_revision, input_revision (card's), is_stale, created_at (card's; null if not stored), source_quote_ids[]
plans[]{plan_id, plan_type, validation_status, total_amount, currency, allocations[]{supplier_id, supplier_name, quote_id, quantity, unit, unit_price}, conditions[], adjustments[], reason}

counter_offer{status, reason, target{supplier_id, supplier_name, target_unit_price, conditions[]} or null, reference{status, unit, requested_unit_price, previous_unit_price, ceiling_unit_price, alternative_total, allowed_range[]} or null, draft_ids[]} or null
questions[]{supplier_id, supplier_name, field, priority, reason, break_even_amount, formula}
unresolved[], decision{decision, plan_id, note, decided_at} or null, allowed_actions[], disabled_actions[]{action, reason_code, message}
numbers: Amounts, quantities and unit prices are Decimal strings without trailing zeros or exponent.

decisions_2026_11_05.review_outcome: A stored agreed value is returned as is. Otherwise: any plan -> OPTIONS_READY (a held counter-offer shows only in counter_offer.status); no plan -> NEEDS_INFO when questions or unresolved exist, else NO_FEASIBLE_PLAN.
decisions_2026_11_05.cards_without_plans: Accepted (plans: []); the graph will store them for role 3/4 HOLD.
decisions_2026_11_05.question_priority: Agent values MUST_CONFIRM / CAN_CHANGE_CHOICE / LOW_VALUE are passed through; the frontend maps labels.

stored_shape_compatibility: Either the current agent shape (no plan_id; allocations with quote_version_id only; old review_outcome COMPLETED/REVIEW_REQUIRED_CLOSED) or the agreed shape (plan_id, supplier_name, unit, unit_price, review_outcome, created_at fixed at save time). Missing values are filled at read time: plan_id = plan-{review_revision}-{index}, names from suppliers, unit/unit_price from the referenced quote. Remove the fill-in once the save shape is fixed with the DB review functions.

actions.closed: archived, accepted, or decision CONFIRM_REVIEW/ACCEPT_INCREASE: allowed [] and disabled [].
actions.stale: All of SELECT_PLAN, HOLD, CONFIRM_REVIEW disabled with REVIEW_STALE.
actions.not_complete: Case status other than Complete (e.g. ON_HOLD card without plans, review running): all disabled with REVIEW_NOT_CURRENT.
actions.complete: SELECT_PLAN when at least one VALID plan (else disabled NO_SELECTABLE_PLAN); HOLD unless the decision is already HOLD; CONFIRM_REVIEW.
actions.pending_agreement: Default rules follow the frontend preview; confirm with frontend. Saving decisions is API-15 (separate ticket).

decision: decision from work_cases.decision; plan_id from selected_plan_id; note from selected_plan_jsonb.note; decided_at from selected_at (null for HOLD/CONFIRM until API-15 defines its storage).

errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: 404: case missing or outside the owner scope
errors.REVIEW_NOT_READY: 404: the case has no stored card
errors.PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: 503: storage unavailable or the stored card shape is invalid
